systemic_findings.name: Incomplete search pagination filtering
Unknown fees normalized to zero
Weak flight identity causing collisions
TravelIntent returnDate conflated with departureTo
Historical observations lack observed_at timestamp
Watch episodes lack single-open-episode constraint
Outbox dispatch not decoupled from worker execution
Missing RLS on private product event tables
Account deletion fails to cascade user preferences
RouteBest selects before PriceScope eligibility
Fast flights worker lacks demand-aware scheduling
Scan runs lifecycle conflates status and health
Generation publication accepts excessive row divergence
Provider error 503 treated as empty flights
Lack of qualified coverage certificate
Mobile viewport horizontal scroll overflow
Keyboard navigation traps in modal flows
Inadequate disaster recovery backup/restore verification
Price history mixes route trends with exact offer
Opportunity detail lacks explainable confidence badge

capability_contracts.title: Independent proof authority
capability_contracts.solution: Gate-level executed assertions, trustworthy raw receipts, source dependency digests and independent owner admission.
capability_contracts.acceptance: A forged PASS, parent SHA proof or tampered result cannot close an unrelated mandatory gate.

capability_contracts.title: One release manifest
capability_contracts.solution: Versioned runtime tuple covering frontend, source commit, database, Edge Functions, worker, scheduled jobs and active generation.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Historical preview and production SHAs do not falsely reconcile.

capability_contracts.title: Four canonical identities
capability_contracts.solution: Separate PhysicalItinerary, CommercialOffer, FareObservation and Opportunity with versioned IDs and migration aliases.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Distinct flights do not merge; Saved and Watch retain identity through generation rollover.

capability_contracts.title: Full TravelIntent
capability_contracts.solution: Typed trip kind, airport/city scope, outbound/inbound dates, travelers, cabin, stop requirements, baggage and price basis.
capability_contracts.acceptance: A full UI→API→DB→worker→decision round trip loses no material travel intent field.

capability_contracts.title: Unknown semantics
capability_contracts.solution: Use explicit KNOWN, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE semantics across source, price and travel data.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Unknown stop count, baggage and tax are never silently coerced to zero.

capability_contracts.title: Provider evidence registry
capability_contracts.solution: Versioned provider mode, capability, license/terms, source age, parser state, quota and fallback policy.
capability_contracts.acceptance: HTTP 429/503 or parser failure cannot produce QUALIFIED_EMPTY.

capability_contracts.title: Coverage certificate
capability_contracts.solution: Scan proof bound to exact query scope, provider, dates, partition outcomes, generation and time.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Unscanned or partially scanned dates cannot be represented as verified no-fare results.

capability_contracts.title: Demand-aware worker
capability_contracts.solution: Union all active eligible Watch scopes before prioritizing under quotas, with bounded fairness, leases and retries.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Watch scopes outside the old first-N candidate slice receive their defined service opportunity.

capability_contracts.title: Atomic dataset generation
capability_contracts.solution: Candidate manifest, committed row-count reconciliation, transactional pointer publication and last-known-good fallback.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Crash or partial ingestion cannot expose mixed or false-complete generations.

capability_contracts.title: Authoritative search
capability_contracts.solution: Apply eligibility, full-universe filters, sort and count before cursor pagination on the server.
capability_contracts.acceptance: An eligible offer beyond the first 120, 1,500 or 5,000 rows remains discoverable and correctly ranked.

capability_contracts.title: Best/lowest truth
capability_contracts.solution: Arithmetic minimum across fully eligible comparable offers under one PriceScope, with separate unknown/excluded candidate counts.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Different cabins, passenger mixes, return dates or unknown required fees cannot be compared as one exact total.

capability_contracts.title: Comparable pricing
capability_contracts.solution: Exact PriceScope cohorts, independent scan epochs, duplicate controls and non-self-comparison. For STRONG historical claims preserve the original threshold: at least 12 independent comparable observations and at least 3 scan epochs, subject to original contract verification.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Multiple records from one scan never manufacture STRONG historical evidence.

capability_contracts.title: Explainable price label
capability_contracts.solution: Separate price exceptionality, freshness, confidence, evidence strength, cost uncertainty and journey fit.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Low-evidence prices cannot receive authoritative discount or lowest-ever claims.

capability_contracts.title: History/Matrix
capability_contracts.solution: Same-offer time-series by observed_at; departure-date matrix by travel_date; comparable cohort as separate product.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Departure date never masquerades as observation timestamp.

capability_contracts.title: Opportunity Detail
capability_contracts.solution: Primary deal card enters Farely's own stable Opportunity Decision Detail; external provider verification is a subsequent CTA.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Card opens the correct durable opportunity with evidence and alternatives.

capability_contracts.title: Saved lifecycle
capability_contracts.solution: Persist stable opportunity reference, saved-price snapshot, observed time, current state, expiry, alias migration and account ownership.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Saved survives refresh and correctly shows stale/replaced/invalidated opportunities.

capability_contracts.title: Watch & notification
capability_contracts.solution: Qualified Watch transition -> durable outbox -> provider acceptance -> delivery evidence where available -> deduped retry.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No duplicate logical notification episode; no strong price alert based on invalid coverage.

capability_contracts.title: Security/privacy
capability_contracts.solution: RLS, grants, RPC access, private credentials, consent, account deletion and bounded public APIs.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Tenant-crossing and privileged RPC abuse tests fail closed.

capability_contracts.title: Performance & accessibility
capability_contracts.solution: Actual hydrated browser tests, accessible forms/focus, real Web Vitals where measurable and manual critical journey review.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No critical user-flow accessibility blocker; report measured numbers instead of fabricated performance scores.

capability_contracts.title: Production release/soak
capability_contracts.solution: Authorized release process, exact deployment tuple, reversible rollout and at least 24 hours of actual runtime continuity for the historical soak gate.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Synthetic time-series or forged elapsed time cannot satisfy longitudinal proof.

capability_contracts.title: End-to-end anti-regression
capability_contracts.solution: Real-module tests, integration, browser journeys, database replay, adversarial faults and preservation proofs.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Critical user journeys survive changes without accepted regression.

capability_contracts.title: Budget-first Everywhere Explore
capability_contracts.solution: Origin + maximum budget + flexible travel period -> destination groups from fully covered eligible scopes.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Do not derive minimum price from first-page results or incomplete markets without a coverage warning.

capability_contracts.title: Flexible Date Matrix
capability_contracts.solution: Per-date observed minimum with same PriceScope, source age, cohort integrity and coverage status.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Missing cells show UNKNOWN, never 0₫ or invented fare.

capability_contracts.title: Airport alternatives
capability_contracts.solution: Nearby airport suggestions with actual transfer time/cost sources or explicitly labeled estimates.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Compare grounded air fare savings against travel inconvenience, not price-only airport swaps.

capability_contracts.title: Personal value of time
capability_contracts.solution: Optional disclosed user preferences for duration, stops and inconvenience; keep objective cheapest independent.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Turning preferences off restores transparent price ranking.

capability_contracts.title: Opportunity rationale
capability_contracts.solution: Expose sample count, independent epochs, comparable cohort, exclusions, observation age and claim ceiling.
capability_contracts.acceptance: A user can understand how Farely reached a recommendation.

capability_contracts.title: Price verification step
capability_contracts.solution: Clearly distinguish observed price, indicative CTA and provider-repriced quote when available.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Measure reported price match/mismatch, never infer a completed booking from a click.

capability_contracts.title: Watch setup from intent
capability_contracts.solution: Prepopulate and explicitly preview exact TravelIntent, departure/return conditions, price, expiry and cadence.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No silent modification of trip dates or traveler composition.

capability_contracts.title: Saved comparison board
capability_contracts.solution: Compare 2–4 saved compatible opportunities by verified cost fields, schedule, conditions, age and uncertainties.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No unknown information silently promoted to known.

capability_contracts.title: Fare movement timeline
capability_contracts.solution: Observed price history over time, with raw observations and missing-scan gaps.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Chart cannot use travel departure dates as historical observation dates.

capability_contracts.title: Fare recheck feedback
capability_contracts.solution: Accept user-reported matched, changed or unavailable price with source and timestamp.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Feedback remains USER_REPORTED until independently verified.

capability_contracts.title: Decision modes
capability_contracts.solution: Separate Cheapest Observed, Convenient, Budget Fit and Lower Risk rankings.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Users can inspect ranking reasons and return to objective price sort.

capability_contracts.title: Discovery empty/degraded recovery
capability_contracts.solution: Separate provider unavailable, no scan, partial coverage, genuinely no eligible offer and stale state.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Provider 503 does not show generic "không tìm thấy vé".

capability_contracts.title: Vietnamese-first travel language
capability_contracts.solution: Natural Vietnamese UI for price units, observed-age, local date/time, baggage, airline and fare conditions.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Real user tasks show comprehension of data limitations.

capability_contracts.title: Digest and noise control
capability_contracts.solution: Instant/daily/weekly cadence, quiet hours, per-episode suppression, unsubscribe and delivery health.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No duplicate notifications and measurable alert burden.

capability_contracts.title: Data provenance UI
capability_contracts.solution: Compact source/age/evidence badges with detailed provenance on demand.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Users distinguish observed vs verified vs unavailable.

capability_contracts.title: Trust-calibrated Buy/Wait guidance
capability_contracts.solution: Longitudinal train/test split, forecast calibration, naive-baseline comparison and confidence limits.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Return insufficient_data until real out-of-sample evidence supports stronger guidance.

capability_contracts.title: Price anomaly detection
capability_contracts.solution: Robust seasonal/change-point analysis with measured precision@K and false-deal rate.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Never make strong anomaly claims on insufficient sample.

capability_contracts.title: Personalized travel feed
capability_contracts.solution: Explicit preference opt-in, privacy controls and controlled retention/saved-outcome evaluation.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No sensitive inference or covert profiling.

capability_contracts.title: Weekend escape templates
capability_contracts.solution: Schedule-aware weekends, local holidays, departure/arrival time and known fare coverage.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Templates must be possible and based on observed supporting data.

capability_contracts.title: Group/family fare planning
capability_contracts.solution: Correct traveler ages, baggage, seats and total-party fare scope.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Single-adult price cannot be shown as family total.

capability_contracts.title: Multi-city itinerary
capability_contracts.solution: Explicit multi-slice TravelIntent and provider-supported itinerary coherence.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No joining unrelated one-way tickets into a fictitious single purchasable offer.

capability_contracts.title: Deal curation and editorial collections
capability_contracts.solution: Human-reviewable collections based on evidence, freshness and expiry.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No fabricated scarcity or unsupported featured discount.

capability_contracts.title: Direct/affiliate provider comparison
capability_contracts.solution: Compare actual provider quote basis, refresh state, link class, partner rights and disclosures.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Commercial ranking does not override undisclosed objective cheapest result.

capability_contracts.title: Anonymous -> account continuity
capability_contracts.solution: Explicit consent-based guest-to-account Saved/Watch transfer with identity isolation.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No silent cross-account merge.

capability_contracts.title: Sharing, referrals and viral loops
capability_contracts.solution: Public links without personal information, bounded abuse controls and measurable acquisition outcomes.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No PII leaks or misleading stale deal shares.

capability_contracts.title: Explore by total trip budget
capability_contracts.solution: Include hotel and ground components only with source-supported data; preserve uncertainty.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No exact trip-total claim with unknown material costs.

capability_contracts.title: Partner integrations
capability_contracts.solution: Provider capability, live repricing, commercial permission, reliability and unit-economics evaluation.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No source enabled commercially without supporting rights and economics.

capability_contracts.title: Mobile-first PWA and push
capability_contracts.solution: Offline-safe experience, permission/consent, cache certainty protection and Watch-driven notification value.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Offline observed fares cannot appear as freshly available deals.

capability_contracts.title: AI travel copilot
capability_contracts.solution: LLM uses typed verified tools and deterministic price computation. No hallucinated prices, routes or available seats.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Empirical usefulness and factual grounding must beat simpler workflows before public activation.

capability_contracts.title: Historical fare forecasting
capability_contracts.solution: Longitudinal unbiased observation data and rolling-horizon backtesting.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No forecasting launch without evidence of calibration and practical value.

capability_contracts.title: Subscription/premium Watch
capability_contracts.solution: Proven recurring alert value, compliant billing, cancellation, support and consent.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No paid launch without commercial and product authorization.

capability_contracts.title: Full ticket checkout
capability_contracts.solution: Licensed issuing/fulfillment, booking provider integration, payment, refunds and support.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No direct checkout launch without authorized supplier and operational responsibility.

capability_contracts.title: B2B Fare Intelligence API
capability_contracts.solution: Explicit source redistribution rights, commercial quota, billing and quality SLA.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No B2B data resale based merely on the license of a scraper library.

capability_contracts.title: Credit-card / promotion optimization
capability_contracts.solution: Actual provider payable price + accurate card/promotion terms and effective periods.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No invented savings or irrelevant cashback catalog.

capability_contracts.title: International language and market expansion
capability_contracts.solution: Provider country rights, currency handling, localized policy and operational support.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No market release without supported data and service model.

capability_contracts.title: Authenticated Watch scoping
capability_contracts.solution: Remote tenant-owned Watch records are authoritative for signed-in users; guest cache must be isolated.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Account A logout -> Account B login shows no A Watch/email.

capability_contracts.title: Watch mutation acknowledgement
capability_contracts.solution: Server-authoritative idempotent pause/resume/delete and UI rollback.
capability_contracts.acceptance: 403/500/offline cannot result in confirmed success UI.

capability_contracts.title: Typed WatchDateScope
capability_contracts.solution: Distinct outboundDateFrom/To, returnDateFrom/To, duration and any-date monitoring horizon.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Return date never becomes outbound window end.

capability_contracts.title: No invented observation time
capability_contracts.solution: Separate provider_observed_at, fetched_at and processed_at; preserve unknown provider time.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Unknown timestamp cannot be converted into "just observed".

capability_contracts.title: Provider date provenance
capability_contracts.solution: Dates must originate from supported provider data and be validated.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Request date alone cannot certify physical flight date.

capability_contracts.title: One-way/roundtrip support boundary
capability_contracts.solution: Typed capability matrix for each provider.
capability_contracts.acceptance: One-way request never silently becomes round-trip.

capability_contracts.title: Immutable response coverage identity
capability_contracts.solution: Each response includes scope fingerprint, source mode, coverage IDs and generation.
capability_contracts.acceptance: A partial result page cannot claim full-market coverage.

capability_contracts.title: Watch visibility & truthful SLA
capability_contracts.solution: Show last checked, actual scan health, expected next evaluation and degraded status.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Stalled Watch cannot appear recently evaluated.

capability_contracts.title: Notification observed-at fidelity
capability_contracts.solution: Every price-specific alert references actual source observation and time.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Missing observation ID prevents a strong fare notification.

capability_contracts.title: Source mode quarantine
capability_contracts.solution: Separate OBSERVED_SCRAPE, CACHED_PRICE, LIVE_SEARCH and REPRICED modes.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Cached fares cannot be labeled purchasable live inventory.

capability_contracts.title: Currency and price scope integrity
capability_contracts.solution: Persist ISO currency, traveler mix, price unit and FX source/time when converted.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No cross-currency cheapest claim without suitable conversion evidence.

capability_contracts.title: Baggage/fare-rule uncertainty
capability_contracts.solution: Known mandatory fees, optional fees, estimates and unknowns are separate.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Unknown baggage is not free or included.

capability_contracts.title: Airport and local datetime correctness
capability_contracts.solution: IATA airport vs metro scope, timezone-aware flight instants and overnight connections.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Cross-timezone or same-city airport alternatives are evaluated correctly.

capability_contracts.title: Canonical client data adapters
capability_contracts.solution: Typed adapters preserve null/unknown instead of Number(x)||0 coercion.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Unknown values survive API -> UI -> Saved -> Watch -> notification.

capability_contracts.title: Watch source quorum and parser mode
capability_contracts.solution: Monitor parser/partition outcomes before certifying successful empty search.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Zero rows + parse failure = provider failure, not verified empty.

capability_contracts.title: Demand scheduler guarantees
capability_contracts.solution: Full active Watch demand union precedes candidate limit and quota selection.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Watch route beyond first-N tracked routes is not silently starved.

capability_contracts.title: Exact vs indicative CTA gate
capability_contracts.solution: Use exact deep links only when validated and allowed; generic/expired links disclose limits.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Generic search link cannot be labeled exact offer purchase.

capability_contracts.title: Browser-cache staleness ceiling
capability_contracts.solution: Cache entries carry observed timestamp, fetched timestamp, source and TTL.
capability_contracts.acceptance: A 7-day-old cache is never shown as a fresh fare.

capability_contracts.title: Cross-user analytics and privacy
capability_contracts.solution: Session/auth-bound pseudonymous analytics and logout cleanup.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No Watch/email leakage through browser caches or queued events.

capability_contracts.title: Verification reconciliation feedback
capability_contracts.solution: Capture observed price vs user/provider recheck result with valid denominators.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No booking or price-match success inferred from mere external clicks.

capability_contracts.title: Transparent partnership ranking
capability_contracts.solution: Separate editorial/affiliate promotion from objective cheapest ranking.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Changing referral revenue cannot silently change price sort.

capability_contracts.title: Secret and quota hygiene
capability_contracts.solution: Server-only secrets, redacted logs, safe provider quotas, rate limits, circuit breakers.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No secret leaks; quota 429 handled without false data truth.

capability_contracts.title: Synthetic-proof adversary
capability_contracts.solution: Gate-bound assertions, source hashes, real elapsed receipts and mutation detection.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Forged timestamps or parent SHA cannot prove new runtime behavior.

capability_contracts.title: Visual intent task tests
capability_contracts.solution: Actual tasks: find, compare, save, Watch, verify and understand data status.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Measurable task success/confusion; screenshots alone are insufficient.

capability_contracts.title: Compact evidence-led cards
capability_contracts.solution: Price basis, observed age, source class and uncertainty in progressive UI.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Users understand observed fare may change before booking.

capability_contracts.title: PWA operational safeguards
capability_contracts.solution: Offline-safe caching, secret safety and stale-data warnings.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Offline state cannot elevate cached fare certainty.

capability_contracts.title: Deal invalidation and lifecycle
capability_contracts.solution: Stable historical opportunity, expired/replaced states and compatible alternatives.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Saved opportunity does not disappear or point to a different physical flight.

capability_contracts.title: End-to-end after schema upgrade
capability_contracts.solution: Forward-compatible DB migrations and Edge/function signature checks.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Old/new consumer compatibility proven in isolated integration.

capability_contracts.title: Real notification receipt chain
capability_contracts.solution: Watch match -> durable outbox -> provider acceptance -> signed delivery event where supported.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Provider accepted is not delivered; logical episodes deduplicated.

capability_contracts.title: Provider source rights registry
capability_contracts.solution: Track source scraping terms, display, caching, redistribution and affiliate rights.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No premium/B2B redistribution without actual rights.

capability_contracts.title: Vietnam-specific travel UX
capability_contracts.solution: Vietnamese airport names, VND, baggage options, holidays and local transport context.
capability_contracts.acceptance: Localized real-data user tasks.

capability_contracts.title: Intent-based itinerary group planner
capability_contracts.solution: Group/family/multi-leg planning only with compatible trip and price units.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No one-person price promoted to total family fare.

capability_contracts.title: Data economics optimizer
capability_contracts.solution: Track cost per scanned scope, eligible offer, verified opportunity and useful Watch event.
capability_contracts.acceptance: No scan expansion without measured marginal value.
